title: Church Worship
definition: Church Worship is the gathered response of God's people to His glory through Word, prayer, praise, ordinances, giving, and obedient devotion.
summary: The Church gathers to honor God according to His Word.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the mediator of worship and the center of the Church's praise.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Church Worship teaches that Christ does not redeem people into isolation but into a gathered, accountable, worshiping, serving, and mission-shaped people. The Church belongs to Jesus, is formed by the Gospel, and is strengthened by the Word, prayer, ordinances, fellowship, and Spirit-empowered service.

This doctrine helps believers see the Church as more than a place to attend. It is the household of God, the body of Christ, and a visible witness to the grace, holiness, unity, and truth of the Lord.

The specific emphasis here is the church gathers to honor god according to his word.. A healthy church life displays Christ's care for His people and His mission to the world.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because many people treat church as optional, consumer-driven, or disconnected from discipleship. Church Worship calls believers back to Christ's design for His people, where worship, truth, love, accountability, service, and mission are held together.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Participate in church life with humility and faithfulness. Let church worship move you to serve, forgive, gather, pray, give, submit to Scripture, care for others, and help the body of Christ grow in love and maturity.
